description: This is a test script for the Work Order doctype in ERPNext, containing unit tests for manufacturing workflows such as stock entry, work order processing, scrap handling, capacity planning, and related operations.

classes.name: TestWorkOrder
classes.description: A test case class for testing manufacturing work order functionalities in ERPNext.

methods.description: Sets overproduction percentage limits in Manufacturing Settings.
